results.title: Made in Lagos, sold as foreign
results.snippet:
Clothes sewn in Lagos are reaching buyers with foreign labels, as some traders at different markets across Nigeria said customers preferred outfits presented as imports. ESE OGHENETEGA reports on the practice, the concerns it raises about misleading buyers, and the struggle to sell Nigerian-made clothes to customers who place greater value on foreign products.
